The story of a ceiling

Look up. A suspended ceiling used to have one simple job: hiding the pipes. From plasterboard and metal panels to composite clip-in aluminium panels, the brief has grown: stand up to wear, skip on-site painting with a PVC film finish, and leave room for an optional sound-absorbing backing. Next time you walk into a lobby, listen: a little less echo might have something to do with the panel above your head.

What can we check before your order ships?

We agree the dimensions, finish and trial-fit requirements with you, then arrange checks at the factory. You can review photos, short clips and measurements remotely before deciding whether to approve shipment.
